'''Phareen flour''' was a type of [[Flour/Legends|flour]] which was used in the creation of the [[pitted ka-olive pie]].<ref name="TOR:PfaD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Phareen Flour was first introduced in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''.<ref name="TOR:PfaD" /> [[Phareen]] is a grain that was introduced in the [[Canon]] story ''[[Forces of Destiny—Hera]]''.<ref name="FoDH">''[[Forces of Destiny—Hera]]''</ref>

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' {{1st}}
